name: ZED BLADE ACA NEOGEO
description:
ZED BLADE is a horizontal-scrolling shoot 'em up released by NMK in 1994.
With the ability to select aircraft weaponry, you can battle in a way that fits your play style.
Join Operation Ragnarok to destroy the giant runaway fortress Yggdrasil.

name: Cartoon Wars 3
description: Cartoon Wars 3 adalah game mobile berbasis strategi yang berfokus pada pengumpulan dan pengembangan berbagai unit. Pemain dapat mengembangkan lebih dari 300 unit berbeda melalui sistem peningkatan level, upgrade, dan fusi, serta menikmati berbagai mode permainan, termasuk konten petualangan dan pertempuran antar pemain (PvP).

name: Slime Hunter : Wild Impact
description:
Game ini adalah RPG 2D side-scrolling bergaya pixel art yang berfokus pada progres karakter dan pertarungan yang cepat.
Pemain dapat membentuk party bersama rekan, membuat perlengkapan, dan mengembangkan karakter sambil mengikuti raid boss serta berbagai mode permainan yang berorientasi pada pertempuran.

name: Baseball Superstars 2024
description:
Baseball Superstars 2024 adalah game bisbol fantasi yang terinspirasi dari seri game olahraga.
Kembangkan pemain unik dan rasakan kembali nostalgia seri Baseball Superstars klasik bersama Baseball Superstars 2024! Pamerkan kemampuan lemparan dan pukulan luar biasa dengan Elite Player hasil ciptaanmu!
Latih para pemain fantastismu bersama para pelatih ikonik dari seri ini!
Ikuti berbagai event seru dan raih segudang hadiah menarik—ayo bergabung sekarang dan nikmati keseruannya!

name: Altalis
description: Discover breathtaking places and unravel countless mysteries across the world of Altalis. As a traveler, you will begin an unforgettable adventure filled with awe-inspiring scenery and hidden secrets. Along the way, you will encounter various beings—some may guide and aid you, while others may harm or hinder your progress.

name: 007 First Light
description:
007 First Light is a thrilling narrative action-adventure game. Follow James Bond as a young, resourceful, and sometimes reckless recruit in
MI6's training program and discover the origin story of the world’s most famous spy.

name: Block Master
description: A fun Tetris-style block elimination game with two exciting modes: Level mode and Classic mode—arrange and clear blocks to enjoy endless puzzle fun.

name: Color Coin
description: The soothing coin-sorting and elimination casual game.Each level serves up a vibrant mix of colored coins scattered across multiple slots—your goal is to swap them strategically to fill entire slots with a single color.

name: Happy Ocean
description: A level - based casual game like Pop Star! Match 3+ identical undersea creatures (clownfish, octopuses, etc.) to clear stages, tackle level - specific goals

name: Mahjong 3D
description: This is a casual puzzle game where players need to match and eliminate three identical 3D Chinese Mahjong tiles; clear the board and you can pass the level and progress onward.

name: Water Sort Puzzle
description: Swap water between cups and sort colors until every cup is full of a single shade. It’s simple, relaxing fun!

name: Warnet Life
description:
Have you ever dreamed of having your own warnet?
Dream no further, because now you can do it all with Warnet Life!
Help the townsfolks by doing their quests and uncover all the secrets in town!

name: Bakso Simulator
description:
Have you ever dreamed of owning your own bakso restaurant? Dream no more, because now you can do it all with Bakso Simulator!
In this world, you'll own your own bakso restaurant with your old friend. Help the townspeople by completing their quests and uncovering all the town's secrets!

name: Kantin Sekolah Simulator / School Cafetaria Simulator
description:
Manage your own Indonesian school cafeteria in this simple first-person simulation game!

Sell Indonesian foods, such as Bakso, Telur Gulung, Cakwe, Mie Ayam, and so much more, to the students and teachers at school!
Join your cousin in following your dreams of having the best cafeteria in town! Expand your cafeteria and decorate it based on what you imagine it to be, explore the town's mysteries and secrets, and meet a cast of diverse characters.

name: Bioskop Simulator / Movie Cinema Simulator
description:
Manage your own cinema in this first-person simulation game!

Sell tickets to customers who want to watch movies in your cinema!

Follow the story of how your sister, Melif, and you on restoring your grandpa's cinema glory! Expand and decorate it in your own style, hire the perfect team to help your business thrive, and explore the bustling city to unearth hidden treasures!

name: Warnet Life 2 / Gaming Cafe Life
description: Embark on an epic journey to become a successful gaming cafe owner, with the help of the charismatic Mayor Egas and his tech-savvy grandson, Ray! Transform your cafe from the very humble beginnings into a thriving hub for gamers!

name: Laundry Store Simulator
description: Welcome to Laundry Store Simulator, the immersive and realistic laundry business simulation game where every wash counts! Start small, grow your laundry store, and become the ultimate laundry business owner in this exciting simulator journey.

name: Comic Book Store Simulator
description: Ever dreamed of owning the ultimate comic book haven? Now's your chance! Transform a humble little shop into a thriving comic book empire in Comic Book Store Simulator! From stocking the latest comic releases to hosting special events, you're in charge of every aspect of your business.

name: Obsessed: Night Shift
description: A PSX Inspired horror game where you must work and cook at a shop late at night and the horrors that comes with it.

name: Project CCTV
description: Play as squad captain of the Critical Containment Threat Verification division and watch live surveillance feeds from CCTV to report any anomalies and survive the night.

name: Obsessed: Trace
description: Haunted by loss and guilt, Arya is lost between reality and delusion as he tries to uncover the truth behind the disappearance of Valeria, the daughter of his late friend that worked at his shop

name: Bushi Navi Global
description:
Bushi Navi Global is a one stop solution for all Bushiroad TCG players.

Locate events near you, get your match pairing, report your match result and even check your previous match results all via Bushi Navi app.

Personalize your profile with titles earned from attending Bushiroad official events!

name: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS
description: This is a multiplayer battle royale action game where players fight with realistic firearms and explosives to be the last survivor on a shrinking battlefield.

name: Resident Evil Requiem
description: Requiem for the dead. Nightmare for the living. Prepare to escape death in a heart-stopping experience that will chill you to your core.

name: Tanki Online
description: Dive into the exhilarating world of Tanki Online, where tanks clash in intense PvP battles! This legendary tank game combines the thrill of shooter mechanics with strategic gameplay. With an arsenal of customizable machines and a variety of combat modes, prepare to unleash your full force in an immersive war of tanks online!

name: PUBG MOBILE
description: PUBG Mobile is a free-to-play battle royale video game co-developed by LightSpeed & Quantum Studio and PUBG Studios

name: Lineage2M
description: Lineage2M(L2M) – The Masterpiece Open-World MMORPG by NCSOFT. Experience 4K visuals, a seamless world, and massive scale battles.

name: Samkok Fantasy
description: All Heroes can be yoURs - Kekuatan Tanpa Batas, Kemenangan Mutlak Selamat datang ke Samkok Fantasy, Turn Based - RPG bergaya anime dengan tema era Tiga Kerajaan. Semua Hero bisa menjadi UR! Ciptakan jalan menuju kemenangan dengan tiap formasi yang kamu buat Rancang formasi terbaik sesuai gayamu dan ciptakan strategi unik untuk mendominasi setiap pertempuran! Dengan kebebasan tanpa batas, kemenangan ada di tanganmu! Nikmati gameplay yang seru dan mudah!

name: Need For Seat
description: Need for Seat merupakan game balapan kart racing yang menggunakan kursi sebagai kendaraan. Di game ini, player akan balapan melawan beberapa pembalap lainnya untuk memperebutkan posisi pertama melewati ruangan-ruangan kantor yang dipenuhi dengan rintangan yang menantang. Player dapat memenangkan game membalap bot yang ada selama beberapa putaran menggunakan fitur yang ada seperti drift, power-ups, dan juga boost.

name: Marbel Pelajaran TK dan Paud
description: Aplikasi belajar untuk anak TK dan PAUD bersama Marbel

name: Perfect World
description: Perfect World Indonesia (Lytogame) adalah game MMORPG 3D klasik bertema fantasi dan mitologi Tiongkok yang masih eksis, dikenal dengan fitur terbang bebas, eksplorasi dunia Pangu yang luas, dan kustomisasi karakter mendetail. Game ini menawarkan pertarungan PvE dan PvP intens, pertempuran udara, serta sering diperbarui dengan konten, job, dan server baru.

name: Echoes of Aincrad
publisherName: BANDAI NAMCO ENTERTAINMENT ASIA PTE LTD
description: Step into the legendary floating castle of Aincrad, a realm of breathtaking beauty and unforgiving danger. What seemed to be a dream adventure has now become a fight for survival. Among thousands of trapped souls, your journey is yours alone; will you rise, endure, and forge bonds that define your destiny? Or will you perish while facing enemies stronger, faster, and more ruthless than you imagined?

name: Tales of ARISE - Beyond the Dawn Edition
publisherName: BANDAI NAMCO ENTERTAINMENT ASIA PTE LTD
description:
300 years of tyranny. A mysterious mask. Lost pain and memories. Wield the Blazing Sword and join a mysterious, untouchable girl to fight your oppressors. Experience a tale of liberation, featuring characters with next-gen graphical expressiveness!

Discover a new fate in this complete version of the award-winning action RPG released in 2021, and the additional content from Beyond The Dawn.

name: Swara Ride
description: Swara Games adalah studio pengembang game digital yang fokus menciptakan pengalaman bermain interaktif dan inovatif,yang dikembangkan oleh Swara Games.

name: Rick Roll
description: Never Gonna Give You Up!

name: FUREA UERZT
description: FUREA UERZT: Mars Code is a high-stakes sci-fi racing adventure where every second decides the fate of Earth and Mars. Master futuristic vehicles, race through gravity-bending tracks, and prove that only speed and courage can rewrite destiny.

name: Paw Rumble
description: Paw Rumble is a 4 people online multiplayer game that lets the player enjoy a short and fun game time with others. Come with a simple mission to bring an enjoyable game without taking too much time.

name: Cursed Mansion
description: Cursed Mansion starts out in a deep forest. A mysterious storm drives Rose to seek shelter in a huge mansion which at first glance seems to be empty. As she enters, the door slams shut and traps her inside. She is forced to look for another way out only to discover something truly sinister has happened in the mansion... and it's still very much alive, lurking in the shadows of the Cursed Mansion.

name: DreadHaunt
description: Set on a forsaken island off Jakarta’s northern coast, a place steeped in arcane energy and unsolved mysteries, you will face anomalous entities, cursed objects, and strange phenomena that modern science cannot explain. Using specially designed tools infused with ancient amulets, you’ll confront these exotic creatures and spiritual threats.

name: Halu - The Fracture
description: An atmospheric, slow-burn psychological horror from a first-person view. Uncover a night that gradually fractures into blurred lines between reality and illusion — and face what should’ve stayed hidden.

name: TypeCaster
description: A once-shameless thief, cursed with a slow, agonizing death, must now embark on a perilous journey to the top of the legendary Tower of Trials. This 2.5D action RPG challenges you to master lightning-fast reflexes and precise typing to battle hordes of fearsome monsters guarding each floor. Harness powerful spells, uncover treasures, and push yourself to the limits in your battle against the unknowns. Will you rise to the challenge and break the curse, or will you become another victim?

name: Neko Michi
description: Build and manage a cozy Meiji-era street for cats. customize buildings, balance tradition and modernity, and create a peaceful cat community

name: Smith's Chronicles
description: Forge your legacy as a blacksmith, transforming a humble village into a sanctuary where humans and fantastical races find home and harmony.

name: Montabi
description: A Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilder where you build your deck by taming and assembling a team of Montabi. Engage in thrilling turn-based battles, strategically utilizing their unique abilities. Assemble a synergistic team and you just might save the city from evil!

name: Teller's Duty
description: In 1980, you land a teller job at Kertasia Bank thanks to your distant uncle. But the bank follows bizarre rules set by a foolish government. Face strict policies, tough customers, and moral choices while saving for your mom’s medical bills. Your fate is in your hands.

name: Tu-Ru! A Rhythm Deckbuilding Game
description: Tu-Ru! is a mix of rhythm and deckbuilding game where you act to card's beat.

name: We Are Hiring : HR Simulator
description: An HR management simulator about navigating workplace dynamics, hiring and training a diverse workforce, and balancing professional growth with personal life in a bustling cityscape

name: Acts of Blood
description: Acts of Blood is a Beat ‘em up, Action, 3rd person game which focuses on fast-paced, brutal hand-to-hand combat. Set in dystopian city of Bandapa, Indonesia.

name: Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream
description: Troublemaker 2 adalah game open-world aksi-komedi beat-’em-up game bersetting di kota fiksi Jayakarta Selatan, kota yang gokil di Indonesia. Bermain sebagai Jordan dan Budi bersama dengan band Beyond Dream dan gang Parakacuk. bersama mereka melalui semua rintangan yang menghadang mimpi mereka

name: 1998: The Toll Keeper Story
description: A narrative simulation game where you play as a mother-to-be working as a toll keeper in the fictional country of Janapa, a nation on the brink of chaos. Navigate daily challenges and make difficult moral choices to survive—all for the sake of your unborn child.

name: Feed The Maw
description: In Feed the Maw, you and your crew will explore a perilous island, frantically loot for vital resources, appease the monstrous Maw with offerings before it consumes you, and work together to survive brutal monsters and natural disasters. Are you ready to dive into the fun, chaotic co-op challenge where only teamwork—and loot—guarantees survival?

name: Blades of Mirage
description: Embark on an epic isometric action RPG set in a Southeast Asian-inspired world. As Mira, use your ability to create water-based weapons and explore ancient ruins scattered across unique islands. Confront corrupted, powerful creatures and solve intricate puzzles to secure the ancient relics.

name: Grim Trials
description:
Grim Trials is a heavy metal action roguelite game that combines crafting and character build customization. In this game, players take on the role of Avelin, a girl who has just been recruited as a Grim Reaper Trainee after her death.

Avelin will undergo a series of trials: defeating impure souls, completing tasks from reaper mentors, and cleansing her inner seven deadly sins. All these trials must be completed for Avelin to become a full-fledged Grim Reaper and return to the world to reunite with her beloved once more.

name: AGNI: Village of Calamity
description: Agni, a determined investigator from a covert Indonesian police unit who defied orders and ventures into a remote village despite ominous warnings. What begins as an unauthorized investigation quickly plunges Agni into a horrifying reality

name: Desktown
description:
A minimalist city-builder that sits on the bottom of your screen! Gather resources, set timers, and decorate your town while you do other activities.
All Reviews:
6 user reviews

name: Brimvahl Crowm
description: Action narrative driven combat game

name: Kiko Run
description:
Dari sebuah seri animasi TV berkualitas tinggi yang menceritakan tentang seorang anak ikan bernama Kiko yang hidup di Underwater Valley, ‘Asri Town’.

Bergabunglah dalam petualangan seru bersama Kiko dan sahabat-sahabatnya, POLI, LOLA, PATINO, TINGTING, dan MAYO untuk menangkap KRABBOT.

Sebuah robot rusak yang dibuat oleh TINGTING untuk membantu penduduk Asri Town menyimpan koin, tetapi ternyata melarikan diri dan menghancurkan semuanya.

name: Kiko Survivor
description:
Kiko Survivor is a roguelite time survival RPG with simple gameplay, based on the hit Kids Animation TV series: KIKO.

Tingting's gaming device exploded! Trapping Kiko and Poli in virtual Asri Town. In order to escape, they must harness their new found abilities and battle through waves of enemies and bosses!

name: AyoDance Mobile
description: AyoDance Mobile adalah game dance rhythm sosial dari MEGAXUS yang menghadirkan pengalaman menari mengikuti irama berbagai genre lagu populer. Pemain dapat bertanding di mode seperti Dance Battle, Team Battle, Club Dance, dan Couple Mode, serta mengekspresikan diri melalui avatar, fashion, dan dekorasi ruang. Selain kompetitif, game ini menjadi ruang sosial untuk berinteraksi, berkomunitas, dan bermain bersama teman secara online.

name: KuloNiku: Bowl Up!
description: Game memasak seru yang mengajak kamu menjalankan restoran bakso warisan nenek. Terima orderan pelanggan, upgrade dan kustomisasi tokomu, ikuti duel masak yang menegangkan, dan kembalikan kejayaan restoran warisan keluargamu!

name: Granado Espada Mobile
description: Granado Espada Mobile adalah MMORPG dari MEGAXUS yang dapat dimainkan di mobile dan PC. Pemain dapat mengendalikan hingga tiga karakter sekaligus (MCC), membentuk tim dengan beragam peran untuk menjelajah dunia luas, menjalankan quest, dungeon, dan raid. Tersedia ratusan karakter, kostumisasi, fitur guild, serta mode PvE dan PvP yang menghadirkan pengalaman petualangan klasik dalam format modern.

name: VILLAINS : Battle Royale
description: Villains : Battle Royale adalah game aksi strategi dari MEGAXUS di mana pemain mengendalikan robot unik dengan kemampuan berbeda untuk bertarung di arena. Kumpulkan dan tingkatkan robot, susun strategi formasi, serta hadapi musuh dalam mode PvE dan PvP. Dengan kombinasi aksi cepat dan taktik, game ini menawarkan pengalaman pertempuran robot yang seru dan kompetitif.

name: Warteg Gelora-Restaurant Sims
description: Warteg Gelora adalah game simulasi restoran sosial dari MEGAXUS. Pemain berperan sebagai pelayan di sebuah “warung”, menerima dan melayani pesanan pelanggan mulai dari ojek online, pekerja kantoran, hingga staf parkir. Pemain harus mengingat pesanan dengan baik, menghidangkan tepat waktu, dan mengikuti protokol kesehatan selama pandemi. Game ini menghadirkan suasana keseharian Indonesia, gameplay santai tapi menantang, dan papan skor untuk bersaing dengan pemain lain.

name: Audition AyoDance
description: Audition AyoDance adalah game online dance rhythm dari MEGAXUS yang telah menjadi legenda sejak 2007. Pemain menari mengikuti irama beragam lagu, bersaing di berbagai mode seperti Beat Up, Battle Party, dan Couple Dance, sambil mengekspresikan diri lewat avatar dan fashion. Dengan komunitas yang kuat dan gameplay kompetitif, AyoDance tetap menjadi ruang sosial favorit para pemain hingga kini.

name: Dislyte
description: Dislyte is a Stylish Urban Mythological RPG set in future cities with striking visuals, exuberant beats, and superheroic characters.

name: Dislyte
description: Dislyte is a Stylish Urban Mythological RPG set in future cities with striking visuals, exuberant beats, and superheroic characters.

name: Zombie District
description:
Zombie District adalah permainan Aksi Shooter dimana pemain mengendalikan sebuah karakter di kota mati, bertarung melalui level yang dipenuhi zombie sambil menggunakan berbagai senjata dan keterampilan untuk bertahan hidup. 
Permainan ini menampilkan skema kontrol yang unik, sistem cuaca yang realistis, dan berbagai senjata. 
Pemain dapat membuka kostum dan senjata yang lebih kuat seiring mereka maju dalam permainan.

name: Magic Chess: Go Go
description:
Magic Chess: Go Go (MCGG) is an auto chess (auto battler) strategy game. Players select and deploy characters, build teams, and make strategic decisions during turn-based matches against other players.
The game emphasizes planning and strategy rather than fast-paced actions. Players may use commander abilities and in-game cards to influence match outcomes. The game supports online play and optional interaction with friends.

name: Dadoo
description: DADOO: Twists, Turns, and Mischiefs is an online multiplayer snake and ladder game with superpowers and lots of mischief! Change the course of the game with various skill cards. Push your enemy to their demise. Really, don't be nice while playing this game.

name: Lokapala
description: Lokapala: Saga of the Six Realms adalah game Multiplayer Online Battle Arena (MOBA) 5v5 yang berfokus pada skill dan strategi tim, dikembangkan oleh Anantarupa Studios, pengembang game asal Indonesia. Lokapala merupakan gim esports pertama dari Indonesia dan pertama di Asia Tenggara yang terinspirasi dari budaya regional.

name: Thousands Layered Edge
description:
Thousands Layered Edge adalah game aksi/pertempuran yang disajikan dalam lingkungan 3D bergaya sumi-e yang indah. Game ini mengikuti perjalanan seorang samurai wanita yang bertujuan untuk mencegah perang saudara dengan mengalahkan empat Kensei, yang memimpin pemberontakan terhadap pasukan Kekaisaran. 
Pemain terlibat dalam pertarungan satu-lawan-satu, melakukan serangan dan parry menggunakan kontrol sentuh, dan dapat membuka keterampilan serta gerakan khusus saat mereka melanjutkan permainan.

name: Garena AOV
description: Game MOBA (multiplayer online battle arena) 5v5 epik dengan grafis ultra-HD dan konten premium.

name: Spooky Bubbles
description: A fun and addictive puzzle game inspired by Indonesia’s legendary ghost characters — but we made them cute and lovable! Pop, match, and merge bubbles to clear levels, unlock power-ups, and climb your way to victory.

name: Garena Undawn
description: Open-world survival shooter where players battle the infected, build bases, explore a vast post-apocalyptic world, and team up to survive.

name: HAIKYU!! FLY HIGH
description: HAIKYU!! FLY HIGH, RPG berlisensi yang dibuat berdasarkan serial anime dari Shonen Jump (Shueisha) dan TOHO Animation. Rasakan serunya menciptakan tim impianmu, menantang lawan tangguh, dan menghidupkan kembali momen-momen bola voli yang ikonis.

name: Garena® Delta Force
description: The world's first AAA 24v24 shotoer game!

name: Call of Duty®: Mobile - Garena
description: Fast-paced first-person shooter featuring classic CoD multiplayer, battle royale, iconic maps, and weapon customization, all optimized for mobile.

name: Free Fire
description: Free Fire adalah game survival shooter fantasy terkenal di dunia yang tersedia di perangkat mobile. Setiap pertandingan berdurasi 10 menit akan menempatkanmu di sebuah pulau terpencil bersama 49 pemain lainnya, yang masing-masing berjuang untuk bertahan hidup.

name: Free Fire MAX
description: Free Fire Max adalah game survival shooter fantasy terkenal di dunia yang tersedia di perangkat mobile. Setiap pertandingan berdurasi 10 menit akan menempatkanmu di sebuah pulau terpencil bersama 49 pemain lainnya, yang masing-masing berjuang untuk bertahan hidup.

name: Infinity Nikki
description: "Infinity Nikki" is the fifth installment in the beloved Nikki series, developed by Infold Games. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, this cross-platform open-world adventure invites players on a journey to the mysterious region "Itzaland." Side by side with Momo, Nikki will harness her Whim, don magical Ability Outfits, and use her new Archery ability to embark on exciting new adventures. Step into the unknown and start this one-of-a-kind journey!

name: Liro: Divine Corruption
description: Liro: Divine Corruption is a souls-like action RPG Soulslike developed by Glaid Studio. The game is inspired by Southeast Asian (SEA) mythology with a strong touch of dark fantasy. In a world where chaos screams without mercy after the deadly Bloodveil War, Liro must find a way between reviving his family and seeking revenge.

name: 머지쿵야
description:
A game in which the Kuya characters rebuild an island into a living space through match-3 puzzle gameplay.
Official Website : https://forum.netmarble.com/MergeKuya

name: Higgs Games Island
description:
Higgs Games Island adalah game domino dengan ciri khas lokal Indonesia.
    Ini adalah permainan yang unik dan menarik, ada Domino Gaple, Domino QiuQiu dan banyak lagi permainan yang membuat waktu luangmu semakin menyenangkan.

name: Sniper Zombies
description: Get ready for a new stunning shooting game, the amazing combination of zombie game and sniper game!

name: GetRich GO
description: LINE GetRich GO adalah permainan digital bergenre board game strategi dengan mekanisme permainan yang sederhana dan intuitif. Permainan ini menghadirkan berbagai stage bertema wilayah dunia, dilengkapi sistem koleksi karakter, stiker, dan dadu yang memiliki fungsi berbeda untuk mendukung variasi strategi. Selain itu, LINE GetRich GO menyediakan sistem peringkat kompetitif, fitur interaksi antarpemain, serta mini-game sebagai konten tambahan untuk melengkapi pengalaman bermain.

name: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang
description: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang is one of the most popular mobile Multiplayer Online Battle Arena (MOBA) games worldwide that brings communities together through teamwork and strategy. With over 1.5 billion installations and 110 million active monthly users, the award-winning game is among the top 10 most played in over 80 countries. With an extensive reach across the Asia Pacific region, the multiplayer is available in 139 countries with an expansive global esports presence.

name: Acecraft
description:
2P co-op Shoot 'Em Up game.
Soar through a world suspended high among the clouds as a skilled pilot, commanding your aircraft through mystical islands and engaging in thrilling aerial combat.
Wind up! Time to fix the world!

name: Watcher of Realms
description: USER-FRIENDLY & STRATEGIC GAMEPLAY. With each stage posing new challenges, commanders must choose the best faction and hero combinations to survive.

name: Mobile Legends: Adventure
description: Mobile Legends: Adventure is a free-to-play hero-collector gacha game, with a battle system that is based on battle power, energy accumulation, and tactical hero deployment, and also competitive PvP aspects that make for dynamic and immersive play.

name: Bounce Box Dash
description: Game tentang kotak yang menghindari rintangan dengan kontrol berupa klik pemain.

name: Spamton's Fishing Trip HD Respammed
description:
Spamton's Fishing Trip HD Respammed is a DELTARUNE inspired fangame, aiming to remaster some spamton.net games in DELTARUNE style quality and add new ones along the way.

The main story revolves around Spamton and Jevil on a beach called the "Oceanbrew" inside Asriel's Wii that he totally has and minigames after that are fun bonuses.

name: Persona 5: The Phantom X
publisherName: Iwplay World Interactive Entertainment Technology Co.,Ltd
description: The Persona 5, developed with deep involvement and supervision from ATLUS, offering a uniquely captivating gameplay experience and narrative. Players will be able to explore the familiar streets of Shibuya in the real world and dive into the cognitive world of the Metaverse for adventure. Now, join a brand-new group of Phantom Thieves, uncover unknown Palaces, seize hidden treasures, and immerse yourself in this uniquely charismatic dual-world journey!

name: Silver and Blood
description:
✦ Game Features ✦
[Gothic-Themed Strategy RPG]
A dark fantasy unfurls across the medieval continent of Minexus. With high-quality anime-style cutscenes, striking skill animations, and a distinct gothic aesthetic, Silver and Blood unravels the mystery behind its name.

name: Garena Speed Drifters
description: Garena Speed Drifters a racing game that lets player race,anyone, anytime and anywhere. Drift your way to victory in 3 minutes! Buckle up and grab your friends to race together in all the different modes in the game!

name: Idol Meta
description: Permainan metaverse virtual 3D yang memungkinkan pemain membuat avatar, bersosialisasi, berdandan, punya kendaraan, memancing, berkebun, bahkan menikah di dunia digital. Menggabungkan aspek sosial dan fantasi dengan fitur kustomisasi avatar mendalam dan interaksi unik seperti fashion show dan clubbing, berfungsi sebagai platform virtual untuk ekspresi diri dan pertemanan di Indonesia.

name: ASTRO BOT
description:
When the PS5® mothership is attacked by ASTRO’s long-standing galactic nemesis, scrambling its wires and scattering the crew throughout space, only ASTRO can make things right! 
- Embark on a galactic quest and explore more than 50 planets in search of ASTRO’s lost crew.

This app is designed to be fun and easy to use for a mixed audience of all ages, from young to old. Easy navigation makes it not only usable for adults, but also easy to use for kids.

Air traffic controller minimalist casual simulator.

The game features a "journey" theme with thousands of levels categorized by exotic global destinations, offering multiple difficulty modes and categories to help expand vocabulary.

description: Ball Sort Puz - Color Game, developed by Playvalve, is a logic puzzle game where players sort colored balls into glass tubes until each tube contains only one matching color. The gameplay utilizes a one-finger tap mechanic to move the top ball of one tube into another, provided the receiving tube has space and the colors match.

The vehicles can collide with each other and in some game modes be damaged and explode upon depletion of vehicle health.

Pango Kaboom is a construction game where children stack and combine colored blocks to build simple structures.
Players can also trigger non-realistic, cartoon-style explosions to collapse the blocks and reset the scene.
The game uses exaggerated visual effects but contains no realistic violence, no weapons, no frightening content, and no harm to characters.

name: Block Blitz: Puzzle Adventure
description: Block Blitz: Puzzle Adventure, developed by Playvalve, is a mobile puzzle game where players drag and position varied blocks onto a grid to clear horizontal or vertical lines. The game features multiple modes, including a time-constrained Blitz Mode and a timer-free Relax Mode, alongside daily challenges.

name: JigMyPic
description: Turn your photos into puzzles!

name: Hole Rush: Eat All Puzzle
description: Hole Rush: Eat All Puzzle, developed by Playvalve, is a physics-based puzzle game where players control a black hole to devour objects across various levels to grow in size. The game features strategic single-player puzzles, and a "Zen mode" for a more relaxed experience.

name: Totti
description:
Totti is a gentle, friendly game designed especially for toddlers - a calm, safe space where little ones can relax, focus, unwind, and learn at their own pace.
Through soft animations, tactile mini-games, soothing sounds, and simple relaxing activities, Totti creates a comforting environment for everyday pauses, helping children feel calm, curious, and engaged.

name: Pango Kids: Game pembelajaran
description:
Pango Kids is a collection of interactive stories and simple mini-games for young children.
Players explore scenes, trigger humorous animations, and complete basic activities such as puzzles, sorting tasks, and connect-the-dots.
The app contains no violence, no threats, no frightening content, and no online interaction between users.

name: Sort Journey - Travel Puzzle
description: Sort Journey - Travel Puzzle, developed by Playvalve, is a match-3 puzzle game where players organize travel-themed items—such as souvenirs and snacks—within a luggage grid to clear levels. The game features a global progression system where matching three identical items unlocks new exotic destinations  allowing players to collect unique cultural artifacts.

name: Catag
description: Play with your team against your friends! Collect points by photographing (‘tagging’) other teams or by being the first team to reach locations visible on the app (‘Air Drops’). If you’re tagged, you lose points and are eliminated for 60 seconds. The team with the most points at the end of the game wins!

name: Christmas Coloring pages
description: Christmas coloring book and painting game. Free Christmas apps for everyone who loves santa claus. Color your own greeting cards and send a xmas greeting or wish to family or friends. Christmas countdown has started! The days till Christmas are getting fewer and fewer.

name: Boundaries The Dating Game
description:
Boundaries is a bold, adults-only dating game designed to help you get to know someone new, or rekindle the spark with someone you already know. It's a deep dive into chemistry, compatibility, and connection — with a twist.

Whether you're exploring something new or moving out of the friend zone, Boundaries takes the pressure off the awkward first date. The game builds trust, encourages honesty, and helps you figure out quickly if you're genuinely connecting — or wasting time.

name: Planet of Lana
description:
Play as a young girl accompagnied by her loyal animal companion on a rescue mission accross beautiful landscapes filled of mysteries.
Solve puzzles, evade machines and navigate strange environments full of dangerous creatures, all in a beautiful sci-fi hand-painted universe.
A planet that used to be a place of undisturbed balance between human, nature, and animal has now become something else entirely.

You take on the role of a Celtic tribal chief, building up a small village into a thriving settlement or powerful city through resource management, construction, and strategic decisions. Players recruit armies and magical units, harness the power of druids and mystical artifacts, and engage in combat or diplomacy with thousands of other players worldwide.

name: SpellBee Mastery
description:
## 🐝 SpellBee Mastery – Daily Word Puzzle Challenge

Sharpen your mind and expand your vocabulary with **SpellBee Mastery**, the ultimate **daily word puzzle game**! Whether you’re a casual player or a word game enthusiast, SpellBee Mastery offers a fun and rewarding way to challenge yourself every day.

The game contains no violence, no threats, no frightening content, and no online interaction.

name: PetrolHead : Street Racing
description: Petrolhead: Petrolhead will provide you the high quality graphics and the driving experience you are looking for. Test your overspeed skills and drift skills on asphalt. description: Lords & Knights is a free-to-play medieval massively multiplayer online strategy game by Xyrality. In this cross-platform MMO, you start as a medieval lord tasked with developing and expanding your own castle into a powerful stronghold. Players manage resources, construct buildings, research technologies, and recruit diverse military units to defend their realm or conquer others.

name: SnowRunner
description:
SnowRunner puts you in the driver’s seat of powerful vehicles as you conquer extreme open environments with the most advanced terrain simulation ever. Drive 40 vehicles from brands such as Ford, Chevrolet, and Freightliner as you leave your mark on an untamed open world.

Overcome mud, torrential waters, snow, and frozen lakes while taking on perilous contracts and missions.

name: Cooking Fever: Restaurant Game

description: Classic Sudoku puzzle game designed for all ages. Enjoy five difficulty levels — Easy, Medium, Advanced, Hard, and Extreme — with a helpful hints system when you’re stuck. Track your personal statistics to follow your progress, improve your solving times, and challenge yourself at your own pace. Fully playable offline.

name: Pango Sheep: Kids Count & Play
description:
Pango Sheep is a non-realistic herding game where children look for scattered sheep, gather them, and guide them back to an enclosure.
Players also interact with simple activities such as washing, coloring wool, or exploring different themed landscapes.
Although a cartoon wolf appears, it does not harm characters and presents no threatening or frightening behavior.
The game contains no violence, no dangerous situations, and no online interaction.

name: Flickoids

Testy and ordination and speed against your opponent or against the clock by ticking bal at colored bricks - with many challenging, animated game level, lots of bonus

Hit the notes at the right time and show for everybody that you're a great guitarist. Choose between 3 difficulty levels (Easy, Medium and Hard).

Pango Zoo is an interactive exploration game where children assist cartoon animals with simple tasks such as feeding, washing, comforting, or solving basic problems.

The game contains no violence, no threats, no frightening content, and no online interaction.

description: A free-to-play PvP online naval shooter with fast-paced combat, easy-to-learn gameplay, intuitive controls, and cross-platform play . Choose from 500+ warships and 100+ Commanders, and master tactics on diverse maps.

Players handle team tactics, player transfers, youth development, stadium upgrades, and finances, while matches are simulated based on managerial decisions.

name: 2XKO
description: Online tag fighter featuring characters and locations from the ‘League of Legends’ universe. The primary gameplay is 2v2 battles that take place in an online virtual arcade, where players compete to KO their opponents, win the round, and move up in the ranks.

name: TFT: Teamfight Tactics
description: Auto-chess battler game, where the player will assemble a roster of champions to fight each other on an arena. As players pick their champions, they are able to gain buffs through selecting specific champions featuring various traits, such as "Bruiser" or "invoker." Each round provides the player items and gold, which are used to upgrade their champions.

name: League of Legends: Wild Rift
description: Wild Rift is a 5v5 multiplayer online battle arena (MOBA) game with exciting action where your skills, strategy, and combat senses are put to the test.

name: League of Legends
description: League of Legends is a fantasy-themed multiplayer online battle arena (MOBA) game where players choose from a variety of "champions" to square off in 5v5 PvP battles. Champions must capture objectives and fight monsters or the enemy team to level up, equip gear, and grow stronger to win. You can also purchase content and socialize with others.

name: Legends of Runeterra
description: A digital Collectible Card Game where players will construct decks featuring a variety of Champions, creatures, and spells to deal damage to the enemy's Nexus. These matches can be played against other players (PvP), or against AI opponents.

name: Crossy Road
description: Crossy Road is the 8-bit endless arcade hopper that started it all. Collect custom characters and navigate freeways, railroads, rivers and much more.

name: Last Hunter K : Seoul
description:
It is currently being prepared for its official launch.
Set in a ruined Seoul after nuclear war, this action game centers on one‑on‑one combat. Players anticipate enemy moves, dodge, counter, and strike with weapons such as sword, greatsword, katana, hammer, and bow, each offering distinct styles. Adaptive AI makes battles unpredictable, while detailed customization lets players shape their hunter’s appearance. Solo duels, cooperative fights, and colossal boss encounters define the experience.

name: Billionaire Royale Club
description:
Welcome aboard the Billionaire Royale Club cruise!
Are you ready to roll into your next big adventure?

Roll the dice and rebuild your business aboard a luxury cruise!
Lost it all to a mysterious group? Now's your chance to win it all back with every roll.
Get your revenge against the mysterious group and build the life of your dreams on the high seas.

description: Once a hooper, always a hooper! Basketball for life!

name: Summoners War: Sky Arena
description: Summoners War adalah game RPG strategi berbasis giliran yang dikembangkan oleh Com2uS. Pemain berperan sebagai summoner yang memanggil dan mengembangkan ratusan monster unik dengan berbagai elemen, lalu menyusun strategi untuk bertarung di PvE (Dungeon, Scenario) dan PvP (Arena, Guild Battle). Summoners War dikenal dengan sistem rune yang mendalam, konten kompetitif, serta komunitas global yang aktif.

name: Crossy Road+

Hop back into the adventure with Crossy Road reimagined for Apple Arcade. Navigate freeways, railroads, rivers, and much more.
Join Crossy Chicken to collect all the characters and discover CROSSY ROAD park.

description:
Climb castles with the Crossy Road crew in this adventurous multiplayer arcade platformer.

Shoot out of cannons, ride rainbows, and make your way through a maze of never-ending levels. Bring your friends into the fray with co-op mode for even more chaotic fun!

name: Piffle

name: Piffle+
description: Line up your best shot in this adorable puzzle arcade adventure! Collect an army of cute Piffle Balls to help you clear a mishmash of challenging blocks and obstacles.

name: 플레이투게더 (Play Together)

Play whenever, wherever!
Log in and start making friends with various people from all over the world in Play Together!

description: Officially licensed by Smilegate, CrossFire: Legends is a first-person shooter mobile game that faithfully recreates the classic PC experience. Featuring Bomb Mode, Team Deathmatch, Zombie Mode, and an extensive arsenal of weapons and characters, it delivers authentic tactical combat gameplay.

name: Run! Goddess
description:
Run! Goddess is a fast-paced mobile game that combines parkour and shooting elements. Recruit powerful goddesses, each with unique abilities and weapons, to battle zombies, upgrade your base, and strive for survival in the Last War!

After a zombie virus devastates humanity, some young girls experience a dual awakening, becoming "Awakened Ones" with extraordinary strength. The Joint Front launches the Dawn Goddess Project, forming the Valhalla Special Ops Unit, the Dawn Valkyries.

name: Warpath: Ace Shooter
description: Your mission: Coordinate your forces and defeat the Ravens at air, land, and sea. Use your powerful modern arsenal to defend your Base and break through the Raven blockade. Meet the Ravens head-on, outmaneuver their fleets, and become master of the seas!

name: Castle Duels
description: This game is focused on PvP - epic battles await you in this multiplayer strategy. Real-time PvP mode allows you to fight other players, each with their own experience. This is a real challenge at deck building, strategic thinking and tactical mastery, where only the best may ascend to the heights of glory. Conquer new Arenas to advance and reap valuable rewards!

name: Art of Conquest: Airships
description: Art of Conquest: Airships is a game set in a vibrant fantasy world where players can freely switch between five unique races—Human, Dwarf, Lich, Rakan, and Sylvani—to suit their playstyle.

name: Evony
description:
Shoot and engage in battles！
Build your cities. Train your troops. Expand your empire. Be the king of 7 kingdoms!
All in Evony: The King's Return, the hottest real-time strategy MMO of 2024!

Unique gameplay features:
◆ Challenge a variety of Survivor Levels
◆ Move, shoot, evolve weapons
◆ Use flexible finger controls
◆ Experience the joy of puzzle solving

name: HITMAN World of Assassination
description: Enter the world of the ultimate assassin. HITMAN World of Assassination delivers the definitive stealth action experience, putting you in the shoes of Agent 47, a master assassin. Explore immersive locations, uncover hidden secrets, and eliminate targets with complete freedom of approach.

name: Quiz & IQ test: Triviascapes
description: Trivia Scapes is an exciting trivia and brain training game in one. Answer questions on history, science, geography, animals, and more while improving your memory and logic. Earn beautiful landscape pieces with every correct answer and unlock stunning new views. Mistakes are okay—use coins to restore lives and get helpful hints to pass tricky levels.

name: Clockmaker: Match 3 Puzzles
description: This is a casual match-3 puzzle game with a story-driven adventure setting. Players complete match-3 levels, solve simple puzzles, and progress through a narrative about lifting a curse from a town. The game includes optional in-app purchases and advertisements.

name: QuizzLand. Trivia Brain Test
description: QuizzLand is a fun and educational trivia game with unlimited unique questions across geography, history, science, art, nature, food, and more. Play at your own pace, improve memory and logic, and enjoy helpful explanations after each answer. Explore a trivia maze of 21 questions per level, use hints, complete daily tasks, and try mini-games for brain training. Compete in duels, battles, and leaderboards, or invite friends for extra rewards.

name: Homerun Clash 2: Legends Derby

Time your control perfectly and swing with ease!
Experience all the thrills of hitting an electrifying home run with simple controls!

Hold and release to hit some hard-hitting home runs!
Hit more powerful home runs to dominate the competition!

No more waiting for others' turn!
Real-time multiplayer battle
Enough with the boring golf games! Time for some thrilling excitement without the wait!

Search for the Primeval Highlands in an Epic Pirate Adventure!
Join Aisha and Jaden on an adventure toward the land of the gods known as the Primeval Highlands, where all your wishes may come true.
Assemble Your Crew of Jolly and Stunning Pirates!
Gather up a boisterous bunch of pirates hailing from five unique pirate nations!
Recruit various characters with unique charm and equipment into your dream pirate crew.

name: Overdox

Intense close-up action Battle Royale! Be the last one standing in OVERDOX!
Survive! Become the Champion! 
- Explore various maps including the Ancient Temple, Land of Solitude, Downtown and more! 
- Enjoy the thrill of the fight and scavenge around the closing play zone!

Players can invest in contracts, train Crews, recruit Vigilantes, explore City Maps, attack other players’ Turfs, gather Resources, and participate in combat and non-combat events. Players can join different Families and grow Gardens and Islands. Players can connect with like-minded individuals by creating Clans to participate in Clan battles and cross-server events.

name: The Grand Mafia
description:
The Grand Mafia is a hardcore mafia-themed strategy game. Step into the shoes of a mafia boss, take over turfs, rally your crew, seek revenge for your old man, reclaim the respect that once was yours, and ultimately become the city overlord!
If you're a fan of mafia movies or games, you have to play The Grand Mafia!

name: Super Baseball League
description:
Real-time, speedy, exciting PVP
- Duke it out 1vs1 against ballers worldwide
- One shot to lose, and one shot to win!

name: Hollywood Crush
description: Hollywood Crush is a match-3 + dress-up mobile game set against the backdrop of pursuing dreams in Hollywood. The game incorporates elements of Hollywood movies, grassroots dream chasing, romance, handsome men and women, high-end fashion, and jewelry accessories. Players can advance the plot by completing match-3 puzzles to earn resources and interact with NPCs. Additionally, the game offers the enjoyment of styling outfits and decorating homes.

name: AFK Arena
description: AFK Arena is a globally acclaimed idle RPG distinguished by its unique stained-glass aesthetic and deep strategic combat, allowing players to collect heroes and progress effortlessly without the grind.

name: World League Baseball
description:
World League Baseball is a baseball game everyone can easily enjoy.
It offers a new style of casual graphics and a highly flexible growth system.
With simple controls, anyone can easily throw fastballs and hit home runs.

name: Ace Fishing: Wild Catch
description: Ace Fishing: Wild Catch adalah game memancing kasual dengan grafis 3D, menghadirkan pengalaman memancing di berbagai lokasi dunia. Tangkap beragam jenis ikan menggunakan teknik sederhana, perlengkapan unik, dan skill khusus untuk mendapatkan hasil terbaik.

name: Minilax: Antistress Games
description:
Step into a world where every tap, swipe, and pop is designed to feel smooth, satisfying and stress free.

From punch-to-break challenges to the quirky fun of  stretch-able monkeys, every moment brings something new. With easy controls, charming visuals, soothing sounds and anti stress gameplay, you’ll always find something new to keep your hands busy and your mind calm.
his game contains no violence, blood, horror, gambling, smoking, or adult content.

name: Savage Survival:Jurassic Isle
description: Savage Survival is a strategy mobile game set in the primitive era. Players can manage their own Tribe, tame wild Beasts, train troops, explore the map, and attack other Players' territories, simulating the development and warfare of tribes in the primitive age. Additionally, by creating Clans and engaging in cross-map battles, the game offers both strategic depth and social interaction.

name: Color Cube Match: Sort Puzzle
description: Color Cube Match is a casual puzzle game where players sort colored cubes using a conveyor system and crates. With simple tap controls, no time limits, and strategic mechanics such as locked crates, hidden colors, and shape matching, the game offers a calm and thoughtful experience suitable for all ages.

name: Brilliant Sort: Diamond Puzzle
description: Brilliant Sort is a casual puzzle game where players sort colored diamonds on shelves to reveal pixel art images. Combining relaxing gameplay with time-based challenges, themed levels, and optional power-ups, the game offers a calm yet engaging experience that rewards planning, speed, and visual creativity, suitable for all ages.

name: GrowStone Online
description:
GrowStone Online is a charming 2D pixel-art MMORPG developed by SUPERCAT. Players embark on an adventure to mine various stones and combine them to create increasingly powerful legendary stones.
The game features a unique 'merge and grow' mechanic where players collect and upgrade stones to battle monsters and conquer challenging boss raids with friends.

name: SEGA POCKET CLUB MANAGER
description: Build and lead your own football club in SEGA’s Pocket Club Manager, a mobile remake of the classic “Let’s Make a Professional Soccer Club” series. Recruit real-life stars, train players, manage finances, and compete through leagues using an in-depth football simulation engine. With over 2,000 licensed players and international tournaments, create your dream team and rise from a small local club to the world’s best manager.

name: SEGA FOOTBALL CLUB CHAMPIONS
description: SEGA Football Club Champions is a free‑to‑play football management game where you build and lead your own club from local leagues to the world stage. Make strategic decisions in scouting, transfers, and squad building, with every choice shaping your team’s future. Featuring over 10,000 real players from major leagues and full crossplay support, you can manage your club anytime and rise to become the world’s top manager.

name: SHIN MEGAMI TENSEI D×２
description: From the makers of the Persona series, Shin Megami Tensei Liberation Dx2 is the latest entry in the three-decade-long Megami Tensei video game franchise; bringing its dark themes, thrilling battles and mysterious storylines to life, to mobile platforms! Take on the role of a Devil Downloader, also known as a Dx2. Dx2s are able to summon and command demons using a special smartphone app.

name: Star Sailors
description:
Adrenaline Rush! Rasakan sensasi mendebarkan di ujung jarimu!
Lepaskan kekuatan yang dahsyat bersama timmu dalam pertarungan turn-based yang dinamis.
RPG turn-based kolektibel Star Sailors!

name: Pawpop Match
description: Pawpop Match adalah game puzzle match yang seru dan menggemaskan, di mana kamu membantu karakter-karakter lucu menyelesaikan level penuh warna dengan mencocokkan item dan menggunakan power-up unik. Mudah dimainkan, santai, dan cocok untuk semua usia.

name: Sonic Rumble
description: Sonic Rumble is a fast, chaotic multiplayer party game for up to 32 players. Dash through varied stages and modes like races, survival challenges, and ring battles in short, action-packed matches. Team up in squads of four, play as classic Sonic characters, and customize them with skins and effects. Enter Dr. Eggman’s toy world, overcome wild obstacles, and compete to become the top Rumbler.

name: Citampi Stories: RPG Love Life
description: Citampi Stories adalah game simulasi kehidupa, bercerita tentang perjuangan anak muda yang rela pergi merantau untuk membantu orang tuanya membayar hutang ke desa bernama Citampi, Dalam permainan ini kamu akan merasakan langsung kehidupan dikampung citampi mulai yang penuh petualangan, bekerja mencari uang, bersosialisasi dengan seluruh warga citampi hingga kehidupan asmara yang mendebarkan dengan karakter wanita di Citampi.

name: Sunday City: Life Simulator
description: Sunday City is an eternal summer simulator, where each day is like a weekend, and the city hums to the rhythm of your desires. You don't need to wait for a vacation here — ocean, sun, and neon city lights are always right there with you. Choose your lifestyle: calm and relaxed or full of drive and adventure. Experience that unparalleled vibe and become a success!

name: Last Day on Earth: Survival
description: Last Day on Earth is a multiplayer zombie survival action game with base building, crafting, and shooting zombies in a brutal post-apocalyptic world. Your life depends on how well you loot, craft, and build, turning whatever you find into weapons, gear, and a fortified shelter. Explore hostile lands, shoot zombies, and fight to protect everything you’ve worked for. In this zombie survival world, every piece of loot matters, every wall you build matters, and every mistake may be your last.

name: Frostborn: Survival RPG
description: Subdue the powers of the gods and confront the army of the dead together with your friends. Make the lands of Vikings great again by building a new capital town from scratch and set off for treasures and new victories to the unexplored shores. All of this and more awaits you in the new online survival action RPG Frostborn!

name: Quiz Blitz: Test Brain Game
description: Quiz Blitz is a puzzle-first trivia game packed with visual logic challenges and satisfying “aha!” moments. Solve image-based riddles across topics like music, animals, geography, science, art, and pop culture. Swipe, tap, drag, and think your way through interactive quiz tasks and themed puzzle packs. Play casually at your own pace or aim for 100% completion, earn stars, unlock achievements, and train your brain with every level.

name: Obey Me! Anime Otome Sim Game
description:
▶▷▶Experience a Brand New Game◀◁◀
What if the characters could be by your side, laugh and cry together with you, and become your friend? - or even fall in love with you?
Obey Me! is a brand new otome dating simulation game in which the characters become a part of your everyday life.

name: Otome Games Obey Me! NB
description:
Otome game "Obey Me! Nightbringer"
From the otome game series with over 8 million downloads that took the world by storm comes the latest installment, Obey Me! NB!
In an all-new story, take on adventures in the Devildom with seven unique ikemen demon brothers and try to find a way back to the world from where you came!

name: Selera Nusantara
description:
Ikuti petualangan Siska menjadi MASTER CHEF di Selera Nusantara, game masak-masak pemenang penghargaan. Simulator masak yang mudah dimainkan, cukup hanya mengetuk dengan satu jari.

Masak berbagai masakan kuliner asli Indonesia di game ini. Pecel Lele, Nasi Goreng, Sate Ayam & Kambing, Mi Rebus, Mie Goreng, Bakso, Mie Ayam, Bubur, Ketupat, Martabak, Seblak, dan banyak lagi.

name: Warung Angkringan Nusantara
description: Rasakan kehangatan angkringan tradisional bersama Nenek, wanita bijak yang siap membantumu mengelola warungnya. Siapkan hidangan khas Nusantara, temui pelanggan unik dari seluruh Indonesia, dan dengarkan kisah hidup mereka. Kumpulkan resep rahasia, hiasi warungmu dengan sentuhan tradisional, dan ikuti event spesial untuk mendapatkan hadiah menarik. Nikmati grafik menawan dan musik tradisional yang menenangkan.

name: Summoners War: Chronicles
description: Summoners War: Chronicles adalah MMORPG aksi berlatar dunia fantasi, di mana pemain menjelajahi berbagai wilayah, memanggil Monster ikonik, dan bertarung bersama dalam petualangan epik penuh strategi.

name: Minion Rumble
description: Minion Rumble adalah game strategi dan aksi ringan dengan fokus pada manajemen minion lucu dan petualangan yang membuat tiap sesi berbeda.

name: Summoners War: Rush
description: Summoners War: Rush adalah perpaduan idle game yang ramah untuk pemain santai dengan strategi lewat mode tower defense dan sistem upgrade yang mendalam, cocok buat yang suka RPG strategis tanpa harus main terus-menerus.

name: Tomb Raider
description:
Before there was the Tomb Raider, there was Lara Croft; twenty-one years old and shipwrecked on her first archaeological expedition. To escape the mysterious isle of Yamatai, she must push far beyond her limits, leave innocence behind and be reborn a legend.

Explore Yamatai’s ancient ruins, unlock its riddles and fight for survival against its murderous inhabitants.

name: The World of Magic: IMO
description: The World of Magic: IMO adalah game MMORPG klasik bergaya pixel yang membawa pemain ke dunia fantasi penuh petualangan. Pilih karakter serta kelasnya, jelajahi berbagai area, lawan monster, dan berinteraksi dengan pemain lain secara online dalam dunia terbuka yang penuh nostalgia.

name: Fatal Claw
description: Fatal Claw, sebuah game Metroidvania dengan visual 2D yang penuh warna. Jelajahi dunia bawah misterius dengan caramu sendiri bersama Kisha. Tujuan utamamu adalah menemukan kunci menuju dunia permukaan bersama para penyintas lainnya, sambil mengalahkan musuh yang terinfeksi dan menyerap kekuatan mereka. Mulai petualangan “clawsome”-mu sekarang!

name: Rise of Kingdoms
description: Rise of Kingdoms is a mobile MMO real-time strategy game inspired by history.

name: Guidus Zero
description: Guidus Zero adalah game roguelike aksi real-time berbasis grid. Jelajahi lubang runtuhan yang dikenal sebagai “Scar” untuk mencari roh dan peti harta, serta kalahkan musuh. Teruslah menembus hingga lantai terdalam Scar, tempat sumber kekacauan menanti.

name: Rise of Kingdoms: Lost Crusade
description: Rise of Kingdoms is a mobile MMO real-time strategy game inspired by history.

name: Lone Chef
description: Mulailah petualangan penuh cita rasa di Lone Chef, sebuah game Metroidvania aksi yang memadukan hunting, memasak, dan eksplorasi. Jelajahi dunia yang luas, temui rekan-rekan yang tak terlupakan, dan kejar hidangan paling menggugah selera yang pernah ada.

name: Arrow Escape 3D
description: A fun casual puzzle game where the scene consists of stacked mini-cubes with arrows pointing every which way; remove each arrow cube only when its path forward is clear, and wipe out all cubes to conquer each stage

name: Space Revolver
description: SPACE REVOLVER adalah game petualangan puzzle yang mengikuti perjalanan seorang protagonis yang terjebak dalam black hole yang dahsyat. Dengan pesawat luar angkasa yang rusak parah, kamu harus menjelajahi planet-planet yang belum dipetakan, memecahkan berbagai teka-teki, memperbaiki kapalmu, dan menemukan jalan pulang.
